title: SourceMandateNotification
description:
Source mandate notifications should be created when a notification related to
a source mandate must be sent to the payer. They will trigger a webhook or
deliver an email to the customer.

amount.description: A positive integer in the smallest currency unit (that is, 100 cents for $1.00, or 1 for ¥1, Japanese Yen being a zero-decimal currency) representing the amount associated with the mandate notification. The amount is expressed in the currency of the underlying source. Required if the notification type is `debit_initiated`.

created.description: Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.

livemode.description: If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.

object.description: String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value.

reason.description: The reason of the mandate notification. Valid reasons are `mandate_confirmed` or `debit_initiated`.

status.description: The status of the mandate notification. Valid statuses are `pending` or `submitted`.

type.description: The type of source this mandate notification is attached to. Should be the source type identifier code for the payment method, such as `three_d_secure`.
